name: @myguard-labs/astgrep-rules
description: Curated ast-grep security and correctness rules

scripts.test: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' && ast-grep test --include-off -c sgconfig.yml --filter '(^((js|go|java|sh|c|nginx|zstd|lua|wp|php|py)-)|-(c|cpp|csharp|go|html|java|javascript|kotlin|php|python|ruby|rust|scala|swift|typescript)$)'
scripts.test:mechanics: python3 tools/rule-mechanics.py check-plans && python3 tools/rule-mechanics.py validate-fixes --unplanned-only && python3 tools/rule-mechanics.py corpus-check
scripts.test:powershell: ast-grep test -c sgconfig.powershell.yml && python3 -m unittest tests.test_powershell_parser tests.test_arm_coverage.ArmCoverageTests.test_current_matcher_arm_inventory_powershell tests.test_arm_coverage.ArmCoverageTests.test_classified_arms_have_distinguishing_counts_powershell -v
